name: ECDB
description: ECDB gives you instant access to e-commerce market intelligence based on billions of real transactions and thousands of other sources. Query retailer revenues, market sizes, category rankings, and conversion KPIs across 100+ countries — directly in Claude. No dashboard switching, no manual exports. Just ask, and get the data you need to benchmark competitors, analyze markets, and identify growth opportunities. Powered by real transaction data, updated monthly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ECDB to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ECDB to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ecdb.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ECDB MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ECDB provides these MCP tools: calculate_gmv_breakdown, describe_market_metrics, describe_retailer_metrics, describe_store_metrics, get_categories, get_company, get_credit_balance, get_market, get_ranking, get_regions, get_retailer, and get_store.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ECDB?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ECDB in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
ECDB requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ECDB is developed by ECDB GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
